answer_1.quote: Our study includes the preparation of novel public resources covering many languages in the Turkic family... We also present new benchmarks for MT which could be used for assessing different factors determining the limits of MT methods... We test the use of our resources in MT and present the first evaluation results for many Turkic languages.
datasets: Parallel corpus of 75M+ sentence pairs in 22 Turkic languages

answer_2.quote: We employ two widely adopted metrics: BLEU and ChrF.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation campaign using a randomly sampled subset of 250 sentences from X-WMT or Bible... where annotators were asked to rate a translation according to adequacy and fluency on a 5 point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Direct Assessment (DA) test where annotators rate adequacy and fluency.
